name: Blost Connector
author: nzperx

sections.description:
Blost writes and publishes SEO blog articles to your WordPress site through the standard REST API. This optional plugin helps the articles blend in with your theme:

  • fills the custom listing-image field your theme uses (learned from your recent posts, never overwriting anything set by hand)
  • fills the theme’s short teaser-text field, when it has one
  • hands the SEO title and description to Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress
  • assigns the Polylang language

The plugin does nothing on its own. It only answers authenticated requests (a user who may edit the post) and does not send data anywhere. It does not contact any external service: Blost connects to your site, never the other way round. Nothing is collected or tracked.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Nothing else: Blost uses it automatically on the next publish.

1.3.0

1.2.0

  • SEO description support.

1.1.0

  • Teaser text field detection.

1.0.0

  • First release.
